blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Toledo Xignex Trojans will look to extend their winning streak when they take on Alpha Division contenders Pasig and Laguna in the inter-division round of the 2026 Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) GM Wesley So Cup on Wednesday, October 14. Riding the momentum from back-to-back victories, the Trojans are aiming to sustain their surge after absorbing their only defeat of the tournament against the Sudeco-Manila Indios Bravos. Toledo recovered from that setback, beating the Quezon City Chessmates Stallions, 12.5-8.5. They then dismantled the Zamboanga Sultans, 21-0, to improve to a 7-1 win-loss record.
